Vendored from https://github.com/zyantific/zydis tag v4.1.1 (commit a2278f1d254e492f6a6b39f6cb5d1f5d515659dc)
  with its bundled Zycore, https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c tag v1.5.2 (commit 0b2432ced0884fd152b471d97ecf0258ff4d859f)
  (2026-11, ADR 0006, #396).
Licence: MIT. LICENSE is Zydis's and dependencies/zycore/LICENSE is Zycore's, both unchanged.
Files: include/ and src/ (including src/Generated/*.inc) of Zydis; dependencies/zycore/include and
  dependencies/zycore/src of Zycore. The x86-64 decoder that bbcpu, scan.c and bbrecomp.c need.
Not vendored: tools, examples, tests, CMake and Meson files, docs, msvc, resources, assets, man, subprojects.
Local modifications: "/* SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT */" added as the first line of each .c, .h and .inc file
  (the files carry the MIT notice in their own headers, not an SPDX line). Nothing else is changed.
Built by crates/recomp/build.rs as a static library with ZYDIS_STATIC_BUILD and ZYCORE_STATIC_BUILD.
